pure_far_end_no_gain_up.meaning: Shipping far-end-only activity control correctly prevents AGC gain increase; this path requires no AGC candidate.

near_far_agc_speech_preservation.meaning: Paired AGC ON/OFF exact-production SI-SDR contribution is within the frozen -0.5 dB constraint; the earlier large apparent loss was measurement attribution error.

noise_floor_gain.meaning: Low and stepped noise floors receive more AGC incremental gain than the pre-registered envelope, while absolute tail output and clipping constraints still pass.

double_talk_activity_coverage.meaning: Activity double-talk coverage is weak, especially weak-near, but paired AGC speech preservation still passes. This must be investigated as activity-control dependency, not AGC target/limiter tuning.
